title: ISS predicted track and South Atlantic Anomaly passes (SSCWeb)

source.publisher: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Space Physics Data Facility (SSCWeb), served via hapi-server.org
source.name: SSCWeb ISS ephemeris, HAPI dataset 'iss' (positions, IGRF+T89C field, dipole L)
source.license: No license or data-use terms are stated in the HAPI /info response or on the SSCWeb home page (checked 2026-11-14). SSCWeb is a U.S. Government (NASA) service.
source.citation: NASA GSFC Space Physics Data Facility, Satellite Situation Center Web (SSCWeb), ISS ephemeris (dataset 'iss', cadence PT60S, startDate 1998-11-21T00:00:00Z, stopDate 2026-11-29T00:00:00Z), accessed through the SSCWeb HAPI server https://hapi-server.org/servers/SSCWeb/hapi (HAPI 2.0), retrieved 2026-11-14T21:58:12Z. https://sscweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/

caveats: PREDICTION, not measurement: SSCWeb propagates the ISS orbit forward; reboosts and debris-avoidance manoeuvres after retrieval are not in it.
MagneticFldStrth is a MODEL value (publisher: 'IGRF + T89C with Kp: 3-, 3, 3+'), i.e. a fixed moderate geomagnetic activity level, not a forecast of actual conditions.

SAA rule (B < 23000 nT at the ISS position) is a LANDFALL design choice with no published basis; it was picked because it yields roughly six passes per 12 h, matching the pattern seen in SSCWeb data during planning. Low field strength is a proxy for the SAA, not a measurement of trapped-particle flux or dose.
Pass start/stop come from 60 s samples: each time is uncertain by up to one minute.

The 24 h track and 48 h pass window start at retrieved_at floored to the UTC hour (so up to 59 min of the track may already be past at retrieval). freshness.stale_after is therefore PT23H, so the snapshot turns stale before the track runs out.
lat_deg is SSCWeb's Lat_GEO, which is geocentric latitude (checked: atan2(Z, hypot(X, Y)) reproduces it); it differs from map (geodetic) latitude by < 0.2 deg.

alt_km is derived by LANDFALL (WGS84 geodetic height from X/Y/Z_GEO); SSCWeb serves no altitude. The km-per-Earth-radius factor 6378.16 was derived by comparing SSCWeb REST (km) with SSCWeb HAPI (R_E) for the same instants.

Served by hapi-server.org (the HAPI project's SSCWeb server), which wraps NASA SSCWeb; it is not a NASA host. No NASA-hosted SSCWeb HAPI endpoint is listed in the HAPI server registry (hapi-server/servers all.txt).

data.explainer: Where the ISS is predicted to be over the next day and when it should cross the South Atlantic Anomaly, where Earth's inner radiation belt dips closest to the surface and the dose rate aboard rises for a few minutes.

X_GEO.description: X Position in the Geographic coordinate system, also known as Greenwich Rotating Coordinates GRC, or Earth-fixed Greenwich EFG

Y_GEO.description: Y Position in the Geographic coordinate system, also known as Greenwich Rotating Coordinates GRC, or Earth-fixed Greenwich EFG

Z_GEO.description: Z Position in the Geographic coordinate system, also known as Greenwich Rotating Coordinates GRC, or Earth-fixed Greenwich EFG

Lat_GEO.description: Latitude in the Geographic coordinate system, also known as Greenwich Rotating Coordinates GRC, or Earth-fixed Greenwich EFG

Lon_GEO.description: Longitude in the Geographic coordinate system, also known as Greenwich Rotating Coordinates GRC, or Earth-fixed Greenwich EFG

MagneticFldStrth.description: Magnetic field magnitude at location of spacecraft (using IGRF + T89C with Kp: 3-, 3, 3+)

DipL-V.description: Dipole L-value at location of spacecraft. Magnetic field model: Internal: IGRF, External Tsyganenko 89C Kp = 3-, 3, 3+.

fields.time: UTC, ISO 8601 (converted from SSCWeb day-of-year format)
fields.lon_deg: deg east, Lon_GEO converted from 0..360 to -180..180
fields.alt_km: km, WGS84 geodetic height derived from X/Y/Z_GEO (rounded to 0.01 km)
fields.B_nT: nT, MagneticFldStrth as served (IGRF + T89C model)
fields.L: dimensionless, DipL-V as served (dipole L-value, IGRF + T89C)

saa_rule.definition: An SAA pass is a maximal run of consecutive 60 s samples with MagneticFldStrth < 23000 nT at the ISS position.
saa_rule.duration_definition: duration_s = stop - start, where start/stop are the first and last samples inside the run (+/- 60 s).
saa_rule.truncated_definition: truncated = true when the run touches the first or last sample of the window or a null sample; its true extent is unknown and duration_s is a lower bound.

conversions.sscweb_re_km_basis: derived: SSCWeb REST km / SSCWeb HAPI R_E for 2026-11-14T13:00Z..13:05Z (all ratios 6378.16)
